title: result.verification_requested (v1)
description: ResearchOrchestrator instructs EvaluatorAgent to verify the frozen EvaluationReport's new_best result against the frozen RunRecord under the frozen VerifierSpec's protocol (VerifyingBestResult state, state machine V1.10). EvaluatorAgent's VerifyingBestResult mode is M12 -- this is the frozen contract only; no consumer wired yet.

evaluation_report_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen EvaluationReport object to be verified.

run_record_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen RunRecord object underlying the evaluation.

verifier_spec_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen VerifierSpec object whose protocol governs the verification.

spec_interpretation_ref.description: Optional SpecInterpretation carrying a survey validation study.
